source_text: Participants valued privacy and anonymity as major benefits, with stigma and judgment being key concerns. Stigma (anti-MSM stigma, internalised stigma, concealment of sexual identity) drives mental health distress and prevents engagement with services. Fear of stigma and judgment often prevent engagement with mental and other health services among key populations.
